Ohel, 25, was abducted from the Nova music festival during the Hamas-led onslaught of October 7, 2023, which sparked the war in Gaza.

He was one of the 20 last living hostages, all of whom were released on October 13 last year as part of the Gaza ceasefire agreement that was reached that month.

World.title: Two men shot dead overnight in northern Arab towns; no arrests reported
World.content:
Two men were shot dead within two hours in the northern Arab towns of Deir Hanna and Umm al-Fahm early on Sunday, according to first responders.

Police said they were investigating the crimes. No arrests have been reported.

In Deir Hanna, near Sakhnin, medics found a roughly 50-year-old man unconscious in his car with gunshot wounds, and pronounced him dead on the scene, the Magen David Adom ambulance service said.

In Umm al-Fahm, medics later also found two men aged roughly 30 and 38 in a car with gunshot wounds, MDA said.

The younger man was pronounced dead on the spot while the other was taken in moderate condition to the Haemek Hospital in Afula, according to MDA.

Get The Times of Israel's Daily Edition by email and never miss our top stories Newsletter email address Get it By signing up, you agree to the terms

The slain men were not immediately identified in media reports.

There have been at least 150 Arab homicide victims in Israel in 2026, a 17% rise over the same period in 2025, which was the bloodiest year on record in the Arab community, according to the Abraham Initiatives coexistence watchdog.

The watchdog has accused National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir, who oversees police, of gutting programs meant to curb violence in the Arab community.



His first full year in office, 2023, was at the time the bloodiest year on record in the Arab community, with the number of Arab homicide victims soaring to 244, more than double over the previous year, according to the watchdog.

The numbers have since climbed, with the Abraham Initiatives reporting 252 victims in 2025.

World.title: Iraqi star Akam Hashim joins Al Wasl FC, rejects FC Porto bid
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi national team defensive stalwart Akam Hashim has officially finalized a blockbuster transfer to join UAE Pro League giants Al Wasl FC, concluding weeks of intense speculation regarding his professional future.

The highly sought-after center-back made the decisive move to the Emirati club despite receiving lucrative contract offers from multiple top-tier European franchises across both the Portuguese and Turkish leagues.

According to exclusive sporting sources, European heavyweights FC Porto were among the prominent clubs actively bidding for the Iraqi defender’s signature, highlighting the immense global scouting attention he has commanded following his stellar international performances.

To fully understand the magnitude of this transfer, one must look at who Akam Hashim is and how his career reached this extraordinary peak. Established as one of the most resilient and tactically disciplined defenders in modern Iraqi football, Hashim has anchored both domestic powerhouses and the national team with his commanding aerial presence, exceptional interception rate, and calm distribution from the backline.

His reputation as an elite continental defender was permanently cemented during Iraq’s historic journey in the recent FIFA World Cup matches, where he delivered masterclass defensive performances against some of the most potent attacking fronts in international football.

Throughout the tournament, Hashim served as the defensive bedrock for the Lions of Mesopotamia, pulling off crucial goal-line clearances and organizing a highly disciplined backline that defied structural odds on the world stage, which naturally triggered a flurry of scouting bids from competitive European leagues.

Financial specifics and the exact duration of the contract are expected to be formally disclosed by Al Wasl FC management in the coming days, marking a massive acquisition for the UAE champions as they prepare to defend their domestic title and compete in elite continental tournaments with a proven World Cup hero leading their defense.

World.title: PM Al Zaidi offers cash rewards to whistleblowers, clears Green Zone violations
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The Mayoralty of Baghdad has launched an unprecedented enforcement campaign to dismantle illegal property encroachments and building violations outside the residences of high-ranking state officials within the heavily fortified Green Zone.

This operation marks the first time since 2003 that municipal authorities have directly targeted elite government quarters, signaling a fundamental shift in the implementation of public zoning laws.

Acting under the explicit mandates of Prime Minister Ali Falih al-Zaidi, demolition teams and municipal tractors began clearing unauthorized structural expansions, concrete barriers, and private perimeters that had long blocked public roadways and civic infrastructure inside the governmental district.

Simultaneously, Prime Minister al-Zaidi escalated his administration’s systemic anti-corruption offensive on Sunday, July 5, 2026, by issuing an urgent nationwide appeal to all Iraqi citizens. The Prime Minister explicitly called upon the public to report any hidden real estate assets, offshore funds, or illicit wealth accumulated through public graft and state embezzlement.

To incentivize this collective oversight, the executive office directed relevant financial authorities to grant substantial financial rewards and percentage-based cash bonuses to whistleblowers whose tips lead to the successful recovery of stolen state funds.

According to an official directive released by the Prime Minister’s Media Office, this institutional whistleblowing framework serves as a core pillar of the government’s formal ministerial program to restore national wealth.

The administration confirmed that a secure digital communication portal will be launched in the coming days to allow citizens to submit verified evidence of corruption under total legal anonymity and protection.

Consequently, legal advisors expect this combination of grassroots financial incentives and high-profile elite accountability to drastically accelerate ongoing asset recovery operations while systematically deterring future financial malfeasance across the state apparatus.

World.title: Iraq raises its oil production during June
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraq was one of the member countries of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) that increased its oil production during June.

OPEC supplies recovered in June, when Gulf States started producing greater amounts after delays caused by the war against Iran and the resulting closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

According to a survey conducted by Reuters, OPEC output rose by 3.3 million barrels per day in June, reaching a total of 19.43 million barrels per day. This increase was mainly fueled by substantial production increases from Kuwait and Iran, in addition to increased supplies from Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Nigeria, and Libya.

OPEC output during June reflects a rise from the organization’s lowest monthly level since at least 2000, but it still falls far short of its targeted production limit.

Current output levels are also lower than they were during the COVID-19 epidemic in 2020, when global oil consumption fell dramatically.

Seven members of the OPEC+ alliance, including Russia and other producing nations, agreed to raise output in June, but the conflict in the Middle East hampered complete implementation of those plans.

World.title: Iraq to sign deals with Capital TI, Chevron, UCC to build oil pipelines
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The Iraqi cabinet authorized on Saturday the state-owned Basra Oil Company (BOC) to sign a preliminary agreement and non-disclosure agreement with a consortium of US-based Capital TI and Chevron, as well as Qatar’s UCC, to construct strategic oil pipelines.

The consortium will carry out technical and financial feasibility studies to compare routes, including Basra-Haditha-Kirkuk-Ceyhan and Basra-Haditha-Baniyas, according to a statement released by the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO).

The Iraqi oil ministry would not have any financial or contractual responsibilities under these agreements, according to the statement.

The Iraqi cabinet also authorized BOC to sign a consultation deal with US-based KBR for the Basra-Haditha pipeline project.

The Basra-Haditha-Kirkuk-Ceyhan route serves as a crucial strategic infrastructure corridor designed to circumvent insecure maritime routes and enhance the country’s options for crude oil exports.

In early April, the Iraqi cabinet authorized the Oil Ministry to invite specialized companies to submit proposals for the Basra-Haditha pipeline project. This project has the potential to be extended toward both the Syrian port of Baniyas and the Jordanian port of Aqaba, thereby providing direct routes to European markets via the Mediterranean and the Red Sea.

According to reports, the project is an Iraqi venture estimated at $4.6 billion aiming to transport crude oil from the southern Iraqi province of Basra to Haditha in the western province of Anbar.

The pipeline’s capacity is projected to be approximately 2.25 million barrels per day using 56-inch diameter pipes. This design aims to enhance domestic transportation and establish connections to future export facilities.

Reaching Haditha opens up three distinct offshore export routes: the Turkish port of Ceyhan, the Syrian port of Baniyas, and Jordan’s port of Aqaba.

Iraq’s planned oil pipeline network represents a proactive strategy to reduce dependency on Gulf marine routes, which face disruptions.

World.title: US dollar rates face new drop in Baghdad and Erbil at market close
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The United States dollar experienced a fresh wave of depreciation against the Iraqi dinar across the parallel exchange markets of Baghdad and Erbil during evening trading on Saturday, July 4, 2026.

This downward correction occurred simultaneously with the closing of the regional financial bourses, extending a multi-day strengthening streak for the national currency. Financial analysts attribute this steady realignment to an influx of foreign currency supply and strict administrative measures targeting parallel currency speculation.

According to field data compiled from Baghdad’s primary financial hubs, the US dollar closed at 153,700 Iraqi dinars per 100 dollars at both the Al-Kifah and Al-Harthiya central exchanges. This closing rate reflects a notable decline from the morning opening session, where the currency initially traded at 154,250 Iraqi dinars per 100 dollars.

This downward shift immediately influenced consumer-facing retail operations, causing local exchange shops in the capital to drop their standard selling rates to 154,250 Iraqi dinars while adjusting their consumer purchase rate down to 153,250 Iraqi dinars per 100 dollars.

A nearly identical valuation contraction materialized within the Kurdistan Region as Erbil’s parallel markets mirrored the capital’s downward trajectory by the evening closing bell. Trading boards in Erbil documented the final greenback selling price at 153,700 Iraqi dinars per 100 dollars, while local currency brokers maintained an active purchasing rate of 153,600 Iraqi dinars.

Financial observers expect this downward pattern to persist in the parallel sector, forecasting a gradual convergence with the official central bank peg as legitimate commercial import transactions continue shifting toward regulated banking channels.

World.title: Iraq recovers $25 million in stolen offshore funds over two years
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The Iraqi Ministry of Justice announced on Saturday, July 4, 2026, the successful repatriation of over twenty-five million dollars in stolen state funds that had been illicitly smuggled out of the country over the past two years.

Ministry officials emphasized that this milestone is part of a broader, aggressive asset-recovery campaign aimed at executing domestic judicial rulings abroad and reclaiming embezzled wealth, frozen bank accounts, and luxury real estate holdings scattered across multiple foreign jurisdictions.

According to an official briefing provided to the Iraqi News Agency by Ministry spokesperson Ahmad Laibi, these complex asset-tracking operations are being executed in close institutional synchronization with the Federal Commission of Integrity and the Iraq Fund for Asset Recovery.

The legal strategies deployed rely heavily on international treaties, primarily the United Nations Convention Against Corruption, which has allowed Iraqi legal teams to win several landmark international lawsuits. These courtroom victories not only facilitated the liquidation and return of cash reserves but also successfully lifted historical attachment orders and legal freezes on sovereign Iraqi assets held overseas.

The ongoing recovery apparatus extends far beyond liquid cash to target high-value real estate investments and hidden corporate equities purchased by former officials and fugitive convicts using siphoned public funds. The Ministry of Justice is actively enforcing final, non-appealable Iraqi criminal verdicts within foreign courts by working through formal diplomatic channels and retaining specialized international law firms.

Government advisors confirmed that numerous parallel files involving secret bank accounts and premium properties in several regional and Western capitals remain under active investigation, reiterating that enforcement operations will continue unabated until all smuggled state assets are returned to the national treasury.

World.title: Iraq oil exports surge to 800K bpd amid broad gulf rebound
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – A comprehensive market report published by Reuters reveals a sharp recovery and an expansive surge in Iraqi and Gulf crude oil exports during June, fueled directly by a diplomatic detente between the United States and Iran that resolved a severe maritime crisis paralyzing major shipping lanes.

According to consolidated data monitored by international tanker-tracking firms Kpler, Vortexa, and LSEG models, the aggregate exports of the five major Gulf oil producers surged by over three million barrels per day, comfortably crossing the ten million barrels per day threshold as critical operational and political constraints eased across the region.

Iraq achieved a dramatic turnaround in its shipping volumes, with crude exports leaping to approximately 800,000 barrels per day from a severely depressed baseline of just 260,000 barrels per day in May, which had marked the peak of structural bottlenecking and regional naval standoffs.

Similarly, Kuwait successfully restored its export capacity to 800,000 barrels per day while boosting its absolute domestic production ceiling to 1.65 million barrels per day, while Iran leveraged the relaxed geopolitical curbs to expand its own crude exports by 70 percent, pushing its volume up to 640,000 barrels per day.

The United Arab Emirates spearheaded the broader regional recovery by setting historic export records, capitalizing on its previous exit from the OPEC alliance to maintain absolute sovereign flexibility to scale up production without cartel-mandated supply cuts.

Abu Dhabi also benefited from the strategic utilization of alternative overland pipeline systems that bypass the vulnerable Strait of Hormuz entirely, alongside aggressive logistics maneuvers by state-owned ADNOC to liquidate its massive floating storage capacity and dump millions of previously trapped maritime barrels onto the global market.

Through these measures, the United Arab Emirates expanded its total exports to an unprecedented 3.8 million barrels per day, while Saudi Arabia maintained its market-dominant position by scaling its own outward flows up to 4.52 million barrels per day.

World.title: Iraq Ministry of Justice releases 640 inmates during June
World.content:
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The Iraqi Ministry of Justice announced on Saturday, July 4, 2026, the official release of 640 inmates from various correctional facilities across Baghdad and the provinces during June.

The monthly census, compiled and verified by the Iraqi Correctional Department, reflects the government’s ongoing administrative efforts to expedite legal processing times and systematically manage detention capacities.

According to the official statement received by the Iraqi News Agency (INA), the legal pathways governing the release of the 640 individuals are categorized below:

Standard Judicial Rulings (Completion of term, conditional release, or acquittals) 419 General Amnesty Law Provisions (Statutory pardons) 221 Total Releases (June 2026) 640

The Ministry of Justice emphasized that the Iraqi Correctional Department maintains continuous coordination with the judiciary to process releases immediately upon the completion of standard security background checks and paperwork validation.

World.title: ‘Vote chori, seat chori, chanda chori’: Congress attacks BJP over Ayodhya donation row
World.content:
File photo: Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh (Picture credit: PTI)

Demands Supreme Court-monitored probe

BJP-RSS ecosystem under fire

Probe underway after FIR and arrests

NEW DELHI: The Congress on Sunday launched a sharp attack on the BJP and the RSS over the alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya, calling it a âscamâ carried out by the BJP-RSS ecosystem and questioning the silence of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union home minister Amit Shah.Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh alleged that the BJPâs politics now revolved around a three-pronged strategy of âvote chori, seat chori, chanda choriâ (vote theft, seat theft and donation theft), reported news agency PTI.Ramesh also criticised the RSS for its response to the controversy, calling its statement âdisgraceful and shamefulâ.He alleged that the organisation, which often claims to uphold integrity and nationalism, had failed to address the seriousness of the allegations.Claiming that donations worth âthousands of croresâ had been siphoned off, Ramesh demanded an inquiry monitored by a sitting Supreme Court judge and strict action against all those found guilty.âDonations running into thousands of crores have been siphoned off. Of course, there should be an inquiry by a sitting Supreme Court judge, of course the toughest action should be taken against all the accused but the silence of the prime minister and the home minister is shocking,â he said.Ramesh argued that Prime Minister Modi, who had taken credit for the construction and inauguration of the Ram Temple on January 22, 2024, should publicly respond to the controversy.âWe expect the prime minister, who took credit for building the Ram Temple... to make a statement. They have been completely silent,â he said.The Congress leader linked the alleged donation irregularities with the BJPâs past funding practices, referring to the now-scrapped electoral bonds scheme.âRemember the electoral bond scheme. It was struck down by the Supreme Court. Hundreds of crores were collected â âchanda do dhanda loâ. So this whole âchanda businessâ is part of the BJP's DNA,â Ramesh alleged.He further claimed that members of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust were closely associated with the BJP-RSS ecosystem and questioned whether senior leaders were unaware of what had allegedly taken place.âTo think that the RSS did not know what is happening, to think that the PM and HM did not know what was happening, is beyond imagination,â he said, adding that the âwhole enterprise was a political enterpriseâ.Ramesh also questioned the role of former principal secretary to the Prime Minister Nipendra Mishra, saying the system was âa tightly-locked, interconnected ecosystemâ where ânothing escapes the other's attentionâ.The alleged embezzlement came to light after a Special Investigation Team (SIT) constituted by the Uttar Pradesh government submitted its preliminary findings. An FIR was registered on June 25.Police have arrested eight accused in the case. Investigators have also recovered nearly Rs 80 lakh in cash, along with some foreign currency, from six of the accused, while the probe remains ongoing.Reiterating the party's stand, Ramesh alleged that the case represented âa ghotala, a scam perpetrated by the BJP-RSS ecosystemâ, and again criticised the continued silence of Prime Minister Modi and home minister Shah, according to PTI.

World.title: Sealing escape routes, deploying more troops in J&K: Army's hunt for 2 LeT terrorists in Shopian enters Day 2
World.content:
NEW DELHI: An anti-terror operation in

's

entered its second day on Sunday, with security forces tightening the cordon around a dense orchard and deploying additional personnel to block all possible escape routes for two suspected

(LeT) terrorists.

The operation, launched on Saturday in the Meemandar area following specific intelligence inputs about the presence of militants, continued overnight as the Army, Jammu and Kashmir Police, and the Central Reserve Police Force maintained a multi-layered cordon.

Officials said the Army's specialised counter-insurgency unit, Victor Force, has deployed additional troops and illuminated the orchard to prevent the two trapped terrorists from escaping under the cover of darkness or dense foliage, reported PTI.

The suspects, identified as Latif and Zakir, are local residents of Kulgam district and are believed to be affiliated with the banned LeT. According to officials, Zakir joined the outfit in 2024, while Latif became associated with the group last year.

The duo was first spotted through surveillance cameras in the orchard on Friday. When security forces closed in on their location, the terrorists allegedly opened fire, triggering a gunfight.





No casualties have been reported so far.

Officials said the dense summer foliage in the orchard has complicated surveillance, offering natural cover that militants often exploit to slip through security cordons. Additional deployments have therefore been made to seal potential escape routes as search operations continue.

Shopian has historically served as a key transit corridor linking south Kashmir with central Kashmir and the Pir Panjal region.

World.title: New state, old script: Infighting returns to haunt Congress's Punjab poll plan
World.content:
NEW DELHI: The

is staring at a crisis in Punjab. Does this read as a surprise? Well, not really! Itâs the same old story of infighting and power tussle between the state leaders which has played out so many times for the Congress in so many states in the last one decade.

Remember Rajasthan, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and yes, also Punjab in the run up to the 2022 assembly elections. Each of these states had the same story unfolding almost in a similar pattern.

Step 1

: Making of the crisis - power tussle between state leaders.

Step 2

: Incubation period - a procrastinating Congress high command preferring to look the other way

Step 3

: Cosmetic actions - Verbal warnings and probe panels to find the obvious and delay real action

Step 4

: The rebellion - a delayed or at times no meaningful intervention pushing one faction to revolt

Step 5

: The defections - disgruntled leaders leaving the party for greener pastures making it easy for the leadership as they no longer need to act

Step 6

: Electoral defeat - And finally, a loss in the elections

Well, this may read harsh. But this is closer to the truth. Analyse the crisis in each of the states mentioned above and you will find this pattern playing out step by step - perhaps with some variations.

In most of these states, leadership tussle was allowed to blossom into a full blown crisis because of the reluctance of Congress high command to intervene decisively at the right time.

Same script, different state

Punjab crisis

Now, letâs look at the crisis brewing in Punjab.

Around 10 days back,

- the âBhagya Vidhataâ of the Congress - gave a pep talk to the leaders in Punjab. This is what he said: âYou have to fight collectively, Punjab is an important state, and we stand a very good chance â¦ â

Some questions: What has the Congress done to ensure that its leaders in Punjab fight unitedly? What ground work has the party done since its last defeat in the state to claim that it has a very good chance?

Now, either Rahul Gandhi was not briefed about the real ground situation in poll-bound Punjab or he was intentionally ignoring the obvious and following the drill of pep talk.





Whatever be the reason, the cracks in Punjab Congress are now out in the open. And it took just one decision from the high command to trigger this crisis. Ironically, a close look and you realise that even this decision, which was perhaps over four years late, steered clear of any change and focussed on maintaining the status quo in the state.

Congress crisis

Decision four years late?

Well, it was in 2022 that the Congress was decimated in Punjab by Arvind Kejriwalâs AAP.

The grand-old-party came down from 77 to 18 while the AAP went up from 20 to 95. That sums up the story of the 2022 elections.

The Congress had four long years to rejig the state organisation and give the new leadership time to prepare for the 2027 elections. Dissents if any would have been handled with time. But then we all know that the Congress does not believe in the age old adage : âA stitch in time saves nine.â So, nothing happened till the next elections came knocking on the doors.

And finally when the leadership eventually focused on Punjab - it triggered a crisis. The fact that this decision was to âmaintain the status quoâ meant that the state leaders who were hoping to get a prominent role were left disappointed.

Senior leader Manish Tewari, who was assigned no role in the rejig, raised the first voice of dissent with a cryptic note on X in which he wished he had an antidote for the "insecurities of individuals" and "institutions".

Then followed former chief minister and 2022âs compromise candidate Charanjeet Singh Channi - who had led the Congress to its historic defeat five years back. Channi, who lost from both the assembly seats he contested then, is unhappy with the leadership after being ignored for the post of state president.

Channi was appointed as the chairman of the campaign committee but did not bother with the customary thanks to the leadership in a subtle dissent.

A meeting called by âunhappyâ Channi to discuss the leadership issue was attended by several important state leaders posing a question mark on the Congressâs decision to continue with Amarinder Singh Raja Warring as the state party chief.

The BJP was quick to take digs at the Congress. Union minister Ravneet Singh Bittu, a former Congressman (remember Rahul Gandhiâs traitor jibe that stirred a storm) who joined BJP in 2024, took a swipe at Warring.

Bittu recalled a famous scene from Sholay. Drawing a parallel with Asraniâs iconic jailor, whose entire contingent marches away with commands of âright, leftâ while he is left standing alone, Ravneet Singh said a similar situation has unfolded in the Punjab Congress with Raja Warring retained on the top post.

He said almost Raja Warringâs entire team has drifted towards Charanjit Channi, leaving the state Congress chief isolated.

In a tongue-in-cheek remark, Bittu advised Warring to stop resisting the inevitable, join the âChanni wagonâ, and head to Channiâs residence along with the rest of his colleagues.

Result of 2022 assembly elections in Punjab.

Does faction-ridden Congress stand a chance in Punjab?

Well, theoretically âyesâ, but practically perhaps âno.â

Punjab has traditionally been one of the best bets for the Congress over the years. The Congress has won five of the 13 assembly elections between 1966 and 2022 and as a party has given maximum chief ministers to the state.

With Akalis the only challenger for years, the grand-old-party kept returning to power in the state despite controversies and infighting. Even the scars of 1984 - the operation Blue Star and the anti-Sikh killings - did not cause a permanent harm to the partyâs electoral prospects.

Not any more. The 2022 assembly election changed the template. When Arvind Kejriwalâs AAP swept the state by winning 95 seats in the 117-member assembly, it marked the end of a political duopoly in the state.

The magnitude of AAPâs victory stunned not just the political observers but also the Congress and the Akalis, who were anyways on a decline following their breakup with the BJP.

Unfortunately for the Congress, this time around there is also a very aggressive BJP which has already shown its intent for the 2027 electoral battle. The BJP, which had âgainedâ many Congress leaders in 2022 has now added several more AAP MPs in its fold.

Raghav Chaddha, the once trusted aide of Kejriwal and one of the architects of the 2022 Punjab win, is now in the BJP with 6 other party MPs - all from Rajya Sabha. As the election approaches, many more may want to switch sides - both from the Congress and AAP - for obvious reasons.

BJP president Nitin Nabin recently made a three-day trip to the state to galvanise party workers and make a statement of intent.

Punjab Congress - a timeline since 2022

Too little, too late

And now, letâs look at what the Congress did to set its house in order after the 2022 defeat.

Well, literally nothing. It waited for four long years doing very little to settle the core issues that may have contributed to the partyâs poor performance.

In the run up to the 2022 assembly elections, while AAP went around showcasing its Delhi model of governance and convincing voters to give Kejriwalâs party a chance, the Congress was busy prolonging the leadership tussle in the state. Captain Amarinder Singhand cricketer-turned-politician Navjot Singh Siddhu engaged in power tussle.

As the two openly traded barbs, Congress discovered a leader in Channi - a Dalit leader - and gave him the baton.

The end result: Congress lost both Amarinder Singh and Sidhu and Channi lost Punjab.

Ironically, the Congress did not learn its lessons from the 2022 defeat and today faces an exactly similar situation. The Congress has no mass leader in Punjab who can match the popularity of AAPâs Bhagwant Singh Mann. Kejriwal has already declared Mann as the partyâs chief minister face. The Congress leaders say they will fight the

under the leadership of Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge. While this is not surprising, what it means is that the Congress will end up helping the BJP make the Punjab election a Modi versus Rahul contest once again. And we all know who has had the upper hand in all such direct contests that have happened in the last one decade.

So, the question is: Has the Congress missed the bus in Punjab? Well, one will have to wait and see if the people of Punjab are ready for another stint of Congress rule in the state despite all these hiccups.

World.title: 'Stop the ads immediately': Centre's stern warning to Meta over child abuse content
World.content:
Centre cracks down on Instagram over child sexual abuse content

NEW DELHI: The Centre has directed Meta to immediately disable all Instagram s and content that promote or facilitate access to Child Sexual Exploitative and Abuse Material (CSEAM), while issuing a stern notice to the company over the alleged presence of such content in paid s on the platform.According to sources, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has ordered Instagram to remove all paid ads and related content linked to CSEAM and has sought immediate corrective action.The government has also given Meta seven days to submit a detailed explanation on the issue.Sources said the paid s on Instagram were allegedly being used to direct users to external platforms hosting unlawful child sexual abuse material.The Centre is treating the matter with utmost seriousness, particularly the alleged "algorithmic amplification" of sexually exploitative content through the platform. It has directed Meta to take immediate steps to prevent the promotion and dissemination of such material.The notice comes amid growing concerns over the misuse of social media platforms to distribute and facilitate access to illegal child sexual abuse content.

World.title: LNG curbs removed as gas supply eases
World.content: NEW DELHI: Centre on Saturday revoked the emergency natural gas supply restrictions imposed in March during the West Asia conflict, restoring normal gas allocation to fertiliser plants, refineries, city gas distributors and industrial consumers as the ceasefire eased concerns over disruption of LNG shipments through Strait of Hormuz.Saturdayâs decision follows a series of steps taken by govt over past 10 days to roll back emergency measures introduced during the conflict. These include restoration of commercial LPG supplies to pre-conflict levels, the lifting of restrictions on sale of petrol and diesel to commercial consumers from retail outlets, removal of the 200-litre cap on diesel purchases and a reduction in commercial LPG and ATF prices, indicating a gradual normalisation of the countryâs energy supply situation.A gazette notification issued by petroleum ministry withdrew Natural Gas (Supply Regulation) Order, 2026, saying the conflict that had disrupted LNG shipments through Strait of Hormuz is now under a ceasefire, negotiations are underway and sea traffic through the strategic waterway has resumed.The emergency order, issued on March 9 under Essential Commodities Act, had empowered govt to regulate production, sector-wise allocation and diversion of natural gas supplies after suppliers invoked force majeure clauses and cargoes were diverted due to the conflict in West Asia.Under the order, full supplies of domestic piped natural gas (PNG), compressed natural gas (CNG) for transport and LPG were maintained, while gas allocation to fertiliser plants, refineries and industrial and commercial consumers was curtailed to ensure availability for priority sectors.Saturdayâs notification revokes the March-9 order in its entirety.India imports nearly half of its natural gas requirements, with more than half of its LNG imports typically transiting through Strait of Hormuz, making the waterway critical for the countryâs energy security.
